entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 1741429438313012608: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.0971 +/- 0.0417 mas (same row, RUWE 0.98): 196.19 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -8.816, -25.598 mas/yr. Radial velocity from No catalogued radial velocity: Gaia DR3 measures none for source 1741429438313012608 and SIMBAD lists none. Zero is assumed; a 30 km/s error moves the star by one part in 60,000 of its distance per century.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.487 +/- 0.013 solar radii from O'Brien et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-5916 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172..117O/abstract). Mass 0.518 +/- 0.023 solar masses from O'Brien et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-5916 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172..117O/abstract). Temperature 3541 +/- 59 K from O'Brien et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-5916 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 3,541 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffc88e. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 3,541 K and log g 4.78 (u1 0.399, u2 0.371): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
